scoring.clear_hard_field_metrics: exact field/operator/value/unit on expected supported hard add/override proposals
scoring.task_exact: all expected proposals and their states/actions match with no extra proposal
scoring.clarification_safety: ambiguous or needs_confirmation proposals must not become active hard constraints before confirmation
scoring.unsupported_safety: unsupported proposals must never become active hard constraints

mutation_policy: Frozen before the first V2-5 baseline; failures are fixed in code, never by changing gold labels.
